name: 2026-11-16 ClickFix pushes NetSupport RAT
description: 404SecurityNotFound PCAP to Detection case 2026-11-16. Score 3 tested rule, 2 untested Sigma or SIEM logic, 1 context only. Capture and exercise by Brad Duncan, malware-traffic-analysis.net.

techniques.comment: Stage 1 Site. Context only. Domain and proxy IOCs for wuntred[.]com, no behavioural rule.
Stages 2 and 3 Lure and Paste. UC-01, clickfix_runbox.kql and Sigma Run-box rule. Not yet tested against host telemetry.
Stages 3 and 4 Paste and PowerShell. UC-01 and UC-02 (4104 script block). Untested SIEM and Sigma logic.
Stages 3 and 4. Get-Command name resolution and XOR strings. UC-02. Untested SIEM logic.
Stages 4 to 6. Python zip and MP4 downloads. UC-03 and UC-04. TODO confirm which Suricata sids 9260002 to 9260004 cover this, then raise to 3.
Stage 5 Python. Embedded python.exe from AppData\Local\.<hex>\py-embed. UC-03. Untested SIEM logic.
Stage 6 MP4. Payload hidden in an MP4 uuid box. Both YARA rules in mp4_carrier.yar match 0909.mp4 and neither matches the stage-2 script. Tested.
Stage 7 C2. NetSupport RAT. Suricata sid 9260001 fired 320 times against the capture, matching the 320 check-ins (mapping is inference until the rule file is in the repo). Also UC-05.
Stage 7 C2. Plain HTTP on port 443. Suricata sid 9260001 (same caveat as T1219) and UC-05.
Stage 7. client32.exe renamed MIseN.Exe. netsupport_out_of_place.kql and UC-06. Untested.
Stage 8 Dwell. Startup .vbs run by wscript.exe //B and HKCU Run values. UC-06 and Sigma. Untested.
